title: SourceRecord
description: An external source cited as evidence. Learning material is not automatically design authority -- notEvidenceFor exists specifically to stop tutorial content from being treated as evidence for engineering/scientific claims (issue #17, risk 'source authority leakage').

authorityTier.description: TUTORIAL sources may teach but per notEvidenceFor must never alone justify an ESTABLISHED globeragRelevance.claimStatus on a concept.

accessClass.description: Prefer FREE_OPEN/FREE_REGISTRATION per issue #17's source-shelf mandate.

lastVerified.description: Date this exact URL/DOI was last confirmed live and matching whatItTeaches. Stale verification is a real-repo failure mode -- CI should flag records unverified beyond a set window once tooling exists.

notEvidenceFor.description: Explicit scope limit -- what this source does NOT establish. Required even if empty, so omission is a deliberate 'nothing excluded' rather than an oversight.
